97026.title: Default and saved settings show as separate groups in the reports
97026.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 2 users · 1 browser · Google Analytics DebugView and Story 12 reports access · about 15 minutes plus a check the next day
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043). Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher).
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On a QA branch sign in with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView". The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders). This user is the dispatcher.
  • Location: one location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location. Every technician and work order below belongs to this location.
  • Analytics access: you can open Google Analytics for the property the QA build reports to, at Admin > DebugView. The QA build runs analytics in debug mode, so each event appears in DebugView within a few seconds under your user. If you cannot open DebugView, the event checks in this case cannot be done by hand: write "not checked by hand" in the result comment and pass or fail on what you can see on the Work Orders page.
  • Event names to look for in DebugView: work_orders_display_view (a display was shown), work_orders_field_load and work_orders_density_load (the fields and density you have, once per display per session), work_orders_field_toggle and work_orders_density_change (a saved change).
  • [User-B]: a brand-new user who has never opened Work Orders, "ZZAUTOTEST Newbie" (the expected results name this user), with Work Orders View.
  • Your dispatcher has chosen a density (e.g. Comfortable) in an earlier session.
  • You can open the Story 12 reports in Google Analytics (built and kept by Milos Vasic).

Setup

  1. Settings > Staff > add "ZZAUTOTEST Newbie" with a role that has Work Orders View, at this location, and finish the invite so the user can sign in. Do not open Work Orders as this user before step 1. If "ZZAUTOTEST Newbie" has already opened Work Orders (an earlier run), add a new user instead and read the expected results with that name.
  2. As your dispatcher, open Work Orders > Board View > Density and pick a value (e.g. Comfortable); then sign out so the next sign-in is a new session.
  3. Check the setup worked: Google Analytics > Admin > DebugView opens and shows your device within a few seconds of opening any ShopView page. If it does not, carry on but write "not checked by hand" for the event checks, as the Preconditions say.
97026.custom_steps:
1. Sign in as ZZAUTOTEST Newbie, open Work Orders and click Board View. Read the source on the display, field and density events in DebugView.
  2. Sign in as your dispatcher, open Work Orders and click Board View. Read the same sources.
  3. The next day (reports are not live), open the Story 12 reports and find the density and field reports for the test date.
97026.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the events show source default.
  • Step 2: the density event shows source saved (Comfortable).
  • Step 3: the reports show default, saved and fallback as separate groups, with ZZAUTOTEST Newbie under default and your dispatcher's density under saved.
  • A fallback (a setting that could not be loaded) cannot be caused by hand. Write "fallback: not checked by hand" in the result comment.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10593 (Story 12, Google Analytics for display and field usage); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S12-R12, Story 12 report owner, read 8 Oct 2026. Event names and timing: SV-10593 comments by Slavcho Mitrov and Milos Vasic, 6 Oct 2026 (the agreed GA4 event table); earlier event contract on Review Decisions page 853901313 (29 Sep 2026) uses older names.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-R12: “Separate default, saved, and fallback preference cohorts in reports.”
  • Story 12 report owner: “Milos Vasic owns building and maintaining the reports in S12-R4 and S12-R10 to S12-R12. Engineering’s part of this story ends at sending the events; Story 12 is complete when both are done.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.

97033.title: Field selection rate is one combined share across all users, not an average
97033.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 4 users · 1 browser · Google Analytics access · steps on two days of one week, report read after the week · about 20 minutes of work
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043). Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher).
  • Location: one location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location. Every technician and work order below belongs to this location.
  • Analytics access: you can open Google Analytics for the property the QA build reports to, at Admin > DebugView. The QA build runs analytics in debug mode, so each event appears in DebugView within a few seconds under your user. If you cannot open DebugView, the event checks in this case cannot be done by hand: write "not checked by hand" in the result comment and pass or fail on what you can see on the Work Orders page.
  • Four test users at this location with Work Orders view (Settings > Staff): U1, U2 and U3 with see financial data, U4 without. Each has the default Board View fields (VIN/Serial off, Total price on).
  • You can open the Story 12 field selection report in Google Analytics (built and kept by Milos Vasic).
  • Do the steps on two different days of the same week (Monday to Sunday).

Setup

  1. Settings > Staff: add four users at this location (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Rate U1" … "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Rate U4") and finish each invite so they can sign in. U1, U2 and U3 get a role with Work Orders View and see financial data; U4 a role with Work Orders View but not see financial data (Settings > Roles & Permissions > create a custom role, e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST No Money"). Record them as U1, U2, U3, U4.
  2. Check the setup worked: each of U1–U4 can sign in and open Work Orders; as U4, Board View's Fields to display does not offer Total price. If a user cannot sign in, finish the invite first.
97033.custom_steps:
1. Day 1: sign in as U1, open Work Orders > Board View > the Fields to display menu, turn VIN/Serial on, then off, then on again.
  2. Day 2: sign in as U2 and turn VIN/Serial on in Board View.
  3. Day 2: sign in as U3, open Board View and turn Total price off.
  4. Day 2: sign in as U4 and open Board View (change nothing).
  5. After the week, open the field selection report for Board View for that week, filtered to these four users if the report allows.
97033.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • VIN/Serial: 4 users saw it (U1 to U4) and 2 have it on (U1, U2), so the rate is 2 ÷ 4 = 50%. U1 counts once however many times they toggled.
  • The report must not show the average of daily rates. Day 1 = 1 ÷ 1 = 100% and day 2 = 1 ÷ 3 = 33.3%, so their average of 66.7% would be wrong. The correct figure is 50%.
  • Total price: only U1, U2 and U3 could see it (U4 has no financial data). U1 and U2 have it on (default) and U3 turned it off, so the rate is 2 ÷ 3 = 66.7%, not 2 ÷ 4 = 50%.
  • Rounding: write down how the report rounds (e.g. 66.7% or 67%). The number must round from 2 ÷ 3.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10593 (Story 12, Google Analytics for display and field usage); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S12-R10, S12-R7, S12-R13, read 8 Oct 2026. Event names and timing: SV-10593 comments by Slavcho Mitrov and Milos Vasic, 6 Oct 2026 (the agreed GA4 event table); earlier event contract on Review Decisions page 853901313 (29 Sep 2026) uses older names. Tech plan (revised 24 Sep 2026) section 3.21 and Phase 10.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-R10: “Report field selection rate by field and display: distinct exposed users selecting the field divided by distinct users exposed to that available field.”
  • S12-R7: “Exclude unavailable financial fields from field-exposure measurement and its denominator.”
  • S12-R13: “Do not count repeated events from one user as additional users.”
  • Tech plan Phase 10 sample calculation: “Each needs a named owner (product analytics, not engineering) and a sample calculation checked against a seeded week (S12-E2).”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.

97034.title: Weekly use and density spread count each user once
97034.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 4 users · 1 browser · Google Analytics report access · steps spread over one week, report read after the week · about 20 minutes of work
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043). Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher).
  • Location: one location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location. Every technician and work order below belongs to this location.
  • Analytics access: you can open Google Analytics for the property the QA build reports to, at Admin > DebugView. The QA build runs analytics in debug mode, so each event appears in DebugView within a few seconds under your user. If you cannot open DebugView, the event checks in this case cannot be done by hand: write "not checked by hand" in the result comment and pass or fail on what you can see on the Work Orders page.
  • Four test users at this location with Work Orders view (Settings > Staff): U1, U2, U3, U4. None of them has used Tech View or Board View before.
  • You can open the Story 12 weekly display usage and density reports in Google Analytics.

Setup

  1. Settings > Staff: add four new users at this location (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Weekly U1" … "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Weekly U4") with a role that has Work Orders View, and finish each invite so they can sign in. Do not open Tech View or Board View as them before the steps. Record them as U1, U2, U3, U4.
  2. Check the setup worked: each of U1–U4 can sign in. New users are used so that none has used Tech View or Board View before; if a user already has, replace them with a new one.
97034.custom_steps:
1. U1: open Work Orders 5 times this week, switch to Board View each time, and set density Compact.
  2. U2: open Work Orders twice, switch to Tech View, and set density Comfortable.
  3. U3: open Work Orders once and stay on List.
  4. U4: open Work Orders once, switch to Tech View, and leave density as it is (Regular).
  5. After the week, open the weekly display usage report and the density report for these users.
97034.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Weekly display usage by distinct users: List 4 (every user opened the page on List first), Tech View 2 (U2, U4), Board View 1 (U1). U1's five visits count as 1 user.
  • Density spread across users who used Tech View or Board View: Compact 1 (U1), Comfortable 1 (U2), Regular 1 (U4), so 1 ÷ 3 = 33.3% each. No user appears twice and U3 (List only) is not in it.
  • Check the report's user totals add up: 1 + 1 + 1 = 3 users in the density report.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10593 (Story 12, Google Analytics for display and field usage); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S12-R4, S12-R11, S12-R13, read 8 Oct 2026. Event names and timing: SV-10593 comments by Slavcho Mitrov and Milos Vasic, 6 Oct 2026 (the agreed GA4 event table); earlier event contract on Review Decisions page 853901313 (29 Sep 2026) uses older names.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-R4: “Report weekly display usage by distinct users.”
  • S12-R11: “Report density distribution.”
  • S12-R13: “Do not count repeated events from one user as additional users.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.
